BillHeading.Sponsors: House Transportation (originally sponsored by Representatives Fey, Clibborn, Farrell, Moscoso, Tarleton, Ormsby, and Bergquist)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Repealing the deduction for handling losses of motor vehicle fuel.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing the deduction for handling losses of motor vehicle fuel; repealing RCW 82.38.083 and 82.36.029; providing an effective date; and providing a contingent effective date.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 82.38.083 (Deductions—Handling losses—Reports) and 2013 c 225 s 205 are each repealed.
RCW 82.36.029 (Deductions—Handling losses—Reports) and 1998 c 176 s 10 are each repealed.
Section 2 of this act takes effect only if either chapter ... (House Bill No. 1993), Laws of 2015 or chapter ... (Senate Bill No. 5297), Laws of 2015 is enacted by June 30, 2015.
